items.question: What is Zappigo?
items.answer: Zappigo is an AI scheduling, support, and customer service platform that talks to your customers on your site and on WhatsApp, books appointments automatically, and answers questions using your company's FAQ — with someone on your team able to take over the conversation at any time.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answerFree: Nothing! We're in our launch period and Zappigo is free for everyone, including the chat widget for your site and a shared WhatsApp number. No card, no catch.
items.answerPaid: The Basic plan costs R$ 197/month and already includes the chat widget for your site and a shared Zappigo WhatsApp number. If you want a WhatsApp number exclusive to your business, the plan costs R$ 397/month; to connect to a scheduling system you already use, it's R$ 997/month. Each plan includes everything in Basic. Every plan has a 7-day free trial.

items.question: How does automatic scheduling work?
items.answer: You register your services (name, duration, price) in the dashboard, and the bot checks open time slots and confirms the appointment directly with the customer, respecting your business hours — with nobody on your team having to type anything.

items.question: How does WhatsApp support work?
items.answer: Every company that subscribes to Zappigo gets access to a shared WhatsApp number — the same bot that serves your site also serves customers there, automatically identifying which company the customer wants to talk to.

items.question: What if the bot doesn't know the answer?
items.answer: The bot automatically forwards the conversation to a human agent, and it shows up in your dashboard's Inbox tab for someone on your team to answer.

items.question: How do I install it on my site?
items.answer: After subscribing, you paste a single <script> line into your site, nothing else to change, and the chat shows up working right away.

items.question: Is Zappigo a WhatsApp scheduling system?
items.answer: Yes — that's exactly what it is: an AI-powered WhatsApp scheduling system. You don't need to register your own business number to get started (which usually takes days or weeks of approval on other platforms) — Zappigo already comes with a shared WhatsApp number ready to use.
